info.title: TPSClear
info.description: TPSClear screens UK phone numbers against the Telephone Preference Service (TPS) and Corporate TPS (CTPS) registers before an outbound calling campaign. Screen up to 200 numbers in one call, keep your own suppression and consent lists, fetch past screening records as audit evidence, and read your usage.

post.description: Screens up to 200 UK phone numbers against the TPS and CTPS registers and your own suppression and consent lists, and returns a status per number. Each distinct valid UK number is one chargeable check. The record ID for the call is returned in the X-Request-Id response header when the record was stored.

parameters.name: body
parameters.description: The phone numbers to screen and an optional campaign reference.

200.description: One result per number supplied, in the order supplied.

X-Request-Id.description: The record ID of this screening call, present when the record was stored. Pass it to Get a screening record to fetch the stored evidence later.

400.description: The request was malformed, had no phone numbers, had more than 1,000 numbers, or carried an invalid campaign reference.

401.description: The API key is missing, malformed, revoked, or unknown.

402.description: The account behind the key is not active, the CRM account the key belongs to has no active TPSClear subscription, or the account has not enough prepaid credits for this request.

403.description: The key lacks the scope this action needs (insufficient_scope), or was used from an address outside its IP allowlist (ip_not_allowed), or screening is switched off in the TPSClear settings of the connected CRM account (screening_switched_off).

429.description: A limit was reached. The error field is rate_limited when a retry after the Retry-After header will succeed, and allowance_reached or daily_cap_reached when a retry will not.

503.description: The service could not complete the request. Retry later.

post.summary: Add numbers to the suppression list
post.description: Adds up to 10,000 numbers to your suppression list, each with an optional reason and the date and time of the opt out. Numbers already on the list are ignored rather than duplicated. List changes are free and need a live key.

parameters.name: body
parameters.description: The numbers to add, each with an optional reason and date and time.

200.description: How many numbers were added, already listed or invalid, and the new list total.

400.description: The request was malformed, had no entries, had more than 10,000 entries, or would take the list past 100,000 numbers.

402.description: The account behind the key is not active, or the CRM account the key belongs to has no active TPSClear subscription.

403.description: A test key cannot change suppression or consent lists (test_key_read_only); use a live key. Also answered when the key lacks the scope this action needs (insufficient_scope) or was used from an address outside its IP allowlist (ip_not_allowed).

phoneNumbers.description: Up to 200 UK phone numbers in any common format, for example 020 7946 0018 or +44 20 7946 0018. Each distinct valid UK number is one chargeable check. A number repeated in the request is charged once and every copy gets its verdict. Numbers that are not valid UK numbers are not charged and come back as unknown.

campaignRef.description: Optional audit tag stored on the screening record, for example Autumn outbound. Up to 120 characters of letters, digits, spaces and basic punctuation. Echoed back in the response when supplied.

results.description: One result per number supplied, in the order supplied.

campaignRef.description: The campaign reference that was sent with the request. Present only when one was supplied.

phoneNumber.description: The number as screened, in international format, or the input echoed back when it could not be read.

status.description: The verdict for the number. Only clean means the number was screened and is on neither register. Suppressed means it is on your own suppression list and consented means it is on your own consent list, so it was not screened and not charged. Unknown covers a number that is not a valid UK line and a register check that failed, and is never safe to treat as clean.

tpsListed.description: True when the number is on the Telephone Preference Service register.

ctpsListed.description: True when the number is on the Corporate Telephone Preference Service register.

checkedAt.description: When the check was made, in UTC. Registers change daily, so screen again before a campaign if the check is 27 or more days old.

id.description: The record ID of the screening call.

createdAt.description: When the screening call was made, in UTC.

environment.description: Whether the call was made with a test key, against fixture data, or a live key, against register data.

lookups.description: How many distinct valid UK numbers the call screened, which is the number of chargeable checks.

campaignRef.description: The campaign reference sent with the call, or null when none was.

providerFailures.description: Distinct numbers that came back unknown because the register check failed. These are not chargeable.

results.description: The per number results as they were at the time of the call.

RecordSummary.description: Counts of each verdict in the call.

unknown.description: Numbers that were not valid UK lines or whose register check failed.

suppressed.description: Numbers on your own suppression list.

consented.description: Numbers on your own consent list. Absent on records made before October 2026.

key.description: The key that made the call.

last4.description: The last four characters of the key.

name.description: The name given to the key when it was created, or null when it has none.

environment.description: Whether this is a test key, which screens against fixture data for free, or a live key.

plan.description: The plan the key belongs to.

window.description: The fair use lookup budget for the key in the current window.

windowSecs.description: Length of the window in seconds.

used.description: Lookups used so far in the window.

reset.description: When the window resets, as Unix time in seconds.

last30d.description: Rolling 30 day totals for the whole account.

calls.description: Screening calls made in the last 30 days.

lookups.description: Numbers screened in the last 30 days.

approximate.description: Present and true when the lookup total hit its row cap and undercounts.

note.description: The reason recorded when the number was added, or null when none was.

createdAt.description: When the number was added to the list, in UTC.

occurredAt.description: When the opt out or consent happened, in UTC. Equal to Created At when no date was supplied.

count.description: The full size of the suppression list.

suppressions.description: The 100 most recent entries, newest first.

count.description: The full size of the consent list.

consents.description: The 100 most recent entries, newest first.

entries.description: Up to 10,000 numbers to add, each with an optional reason and date and time.

number.description: A UK phone number in any common format.

reason.description: Why the number is on the list, up to 500 characters. For a consent entry, put the consent evidence here.

datetime.description: When the opt out or consent happened, as ISO 8601 (2026-09-18T11:02:00Z) or UK day first (18/09/2026 12:02). A time with no zone is UK time. Defaults to now. Future dates and dates before 2000 are rejected.

ok.description: True when the request was accepted.

alreadyListed.description: Valid numbers that were already on the list.

invalidCount.description: Entries rejected because the number or date could not be read.

total.description: The size of the list after this request.

invalid.description: The raw values of the first rejected entries.

invalidRows.description: The first rejected entries with their position and the reason.

line.description: The one based position of the entry in the request.

ok.description: True when the request was accepted.

removed.description: True when the number was on the list and has been removed, false when it was not on the list.

error.description: A stable error code, for example rate_limited, allowance_reached, daily_cap_reached, insufficient_credits, insufficient_scope, ip_not_allowed or test_key_read_only.

message.description: A human readable explanation of the error.

required.description: With insufficient_credits, the credits the request needed.

balance.description: With insufficient_credits, the credits on the account.

limit.description: With rate_limited on Screen phone numbers, the lookups allowed in the window.

remaining.description: With rate_limited on Screen phone numbers, the lookups left in the window.

reset.description: With rate_limited on Screen phone numbers, when the window resets, as Unix time in seconds.

cap.description: With daily_cap_reached, the numbers the account can screen a day.

retryAfter.description: With rate_limited or daily_cap_reached, the seconds to wait before retrying.
